title: MTAType
description: Details whether the Minimum Transfer Amount is rating based, a fixed amount, or infinity.

fixedAmount.description: Defines that the Minimum Transfer Amount (MTA) is a Fixed Amount.

ratingsBased.description: Defines that the Minimum Transfer Amount (MTA) is based on a Ratings condition(s).

other.description: Utilised where the clause data structure is not able to capture a material aspect of the clause.
